explanation.question_quote: Cardiac catheterization shows 96% occlusion of the left anterior descending artery.
explanation.sentence: Before revascularization, the patient had septal and apical hypokinesis with 96% occlusion of the left anterior descending artery.

explanation.question_quote: follow-up echocardiography one week later shows normal regional contractile function
explanation.sentence: Regional contractile function returned to normal one week after angioplasty and stenting.
Hibernating myocardium is viable heart muscle that contracts less under chronically limited blood supply and can recover after revascularization.
Recovery of contraction in the affected territory after blood flow was restored favors hibernating myocardium rather than structural cardiac remodeling.
